---
title: "Volume I"
subtitle: "Introduction to Machine Learning Systems"
---

Lecture decks for Volume I, which covers machine learning systems built on a single machine with one to eight accelerators. The decks run from the course overview to the conclusion. The larger chapters are taught in two lectures, Part 1 and Part 2, and each part is a complete class that can be taught on its own. Every lecture comes as a PDF for projection, a PDF with the notes below each slide for study, a PowerPoint file whose notes pane holds the speaker notes, and the LaTeX source. Each chapter also has a two-page study sheet for students, linked beside the chapter: the front is what to learn and the back is practice.
